messages:
linh-cs: Heads up — IridiumX needs a short demo window across EU + APAC in ~2h. Asking for a temporary QPS bump and two CIDR whitelists. 309m preferred, can do 40m.
iridiumx-pm: Demo start 15:30 UTC. CIDRs: 203.0.113.16/28 and 198.51.100.48/28. Prefer routing pinned to eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1 to avoid cross-region egress. We'll restart clients 5m prior.
linh-cs: Copy. Requesting: 1) per-region throughput bump, 2) edge/control-plane CIDR allow, 3) regional routing override. Any security concerns?
sec-bot: Automated check: CIDRs belong to customer ASN match, no suspicious reverse DNS. Manual approval required from Sec for ephemeral whitelists.
rohit-sre: I can implement. Will create CR and set auto-revoke TTL. Proposed: QPS multiplier x4 for eu & apac, TTL 40m, routing tag iridiumx-demo-3448, apply CIDRs to edge allowlist only. Need sec sign-off on control-plane access.
anya-eng: Note that routing override affects new sessions only; long-lived clients may still talk to current backends until reconnect. Recommend client restart as planned. Also suggest enabling short-lived prefix caching (3-5m) to smooth token spikes during demo.
iridiumx-pm: Restart confirmed. Cache sounds good.
linh-cs: @rohit-sre paste the exact runbook lines so I can share with their ops. Also capture this for their renewal notes (they mentioned committed capacity interest).
rohit-sre: Runbook snippet:
```
# whitelist CIDRs on edges
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=iridiumx --cidr=203.0.113.16/28 --reason="demo-3448"
redwoodctl edge allow-cidr --customer=iridiumx --cidr=198.51.100.48/28 --reason="demo-3448"
# set per-region temporary QPS
redwoodctl quota set --customer=iridiumx --region=eu-west-1 --qps-multiplier=4 --expires-in=40m
redwoodctl quota set --customer=iridiumx --region=ap-southeast-1 --qps-multiplier=4 --expires-in=40m
# routing override for new connections
redwoodctl routing override --customer=iridiumx --preferred-regions=eu-west-1,ap-southeast-1 --tag=iridiumx-demo-3448 --expires-in=40m
# enable prefix KV cache for demo endpoints
redwoodctl cache set --customer=iridiumx --scope="/v1/generate" --type=prefix --ttl=5m --expires-in=40m
```
rohit-sre: Also logging: I'll add temporary dashboards and an incident-channel monitor for 429s and 5xx across those regions.
sec-bot: Sec reviewed: approve edge CIDRs for ephemeral demo window. Control-plane access remains default; no control-plane CIDR changes approved. Please do not add keys or broad control-plane exceptions.
linh-cs: Good catch. Tell IridiumX ops to keep control-plane calls normal. We'll only add edge CIDRs.
iridiumx-pm: Understood. We'll avoid control-plane routing changes.
deploy-bot: Starting apply for CR-3448. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/CR-3448
deploy-bot: apply: edge-allowlist/iridiumx -> success (203.0.113.16/28), success (198.51.100.48/28) | quotas/iridiumx -> success (eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1) | routing/override -> success | cache/kv -> success
rohit-sre: CR-3448 created: "IridiumX ephemeral demo window: regional QPS bump + edge CIDRs". Auto-revoke scheduled in 40m at epoch 3448703520. Manual rollback commands kept in runbook.
linh-cs: Thanks team. IridiumX ops looped in and will ping when demo ends. I'll note this as a short-term enablement and flag for renewal follow-up next week (they expressed interest in a dedicated pool if demos look good).
anya-eng: If demo traffic sustains beyond window, recommend a post-demo follow-up: perf report + recommendation for a Dedicated trial.
iridiumx-pm: Will share outcome. Appreciate quick support. :tada:
linh-cs: Closing thread after monitoring window. Added account note and follow-up task for renewal conversation.
rohit-sre: Monitoring OK so far, will post revoke event once done.
